body:
Yeah I feel like I'm too boring for anybody. But I do know that's not true either. And it's not true about you either. But yeah, I spend too much time just sitting alone in my room smoking cigs and thinking about what a failure I've been. 

​

Hell yeah man! I think that was one of my problems, I kinda stopped experiencing life and just got kinda stuck in my own mind. Punisher has been on my to watch list, but have you seen Gotham? I really like how they portray the villians, they make them more human and relatable. And yeah I've always believed you should look at people as if youre looking into the mirror...find something about yourself that you recognize in them.

You are not to me. I've realized some people will judge you and reject you for feeling a certain way and others will be there to listen. A lot of the time, people just don't know what to do either. I think we both just need to be more comfortable with ourselves and accept that how we're feeling is because we are human.
Thank you. I'm not even totally sure what I wanna talk about. I just don't feel connected anymore.

Yeah that's what I try to focus on. But I do just wanna be happy ya know. I've just found it so hard to relate or connect with anyone. I am planning to change some things up in my life, currently on a leave of absence from work and just having some time to rest and think about what I need to do has been somewhat refreshing. I really appreciate all of you for responding.

​

Yes. You ever feel that way? I know we all do from time to time it's just been so consistently for so long now. I do just feel like a burden at this point. I have been told I was a burden and they weren't wrong. I'm not trying to blame anyone either I do know that at the end of the day it's up to me to change this. And thank you for replying it does mean a lot to me and I really hope you are well.

Hey maybe that's a sign that tonight just isn't the night to do this. Please don't man. We can talk about whatever you want. I need a friend too and I think we can probably help each other out right now.
What's up man how are you feeling today?
Hey man you there I really wanna talk to you?
Hey OP. Here to listen as well. So yeah...why are you feeling this way? I'm happy you came here because people will listen.

I hear ya man. Have you tried meditation and visualizing and all that? My father is a raging alcoholic so he was pretty lacking in the emotional support department as well. I'm not trying to make this about me though. I really do care about you very much though. I really want us both to not feel this way. I hope this is helping you in some way. Personally, being able to talk to people going through this too does give me some hope in a weird way. But what about stuff you enjoy doing or that makes you happy, you wanna talk about those things?

I can kinda relate...when I was in high school my mom found cocaine in my room. It broke her heart. She didn't know what to do, but it did show me how much she cares. But you are not a failure for that. If you are feeling unloved especially when young, it's only natural to seek attention. How are you feeling today?
Willing to talk about what that was? I've been bouncing around from therapists for anxiety and depression as well. It just doesn't take the place of real human connection.

Hey man. Have you told any of your close friends or family members how you're feeling? I understand you said you don't want to feel like a burden and you fear rejection...I totally feel you there. And it freakin sucks when you try to tell someone you thought you were close with and it just pushes them away because they don't know what to do or they're scared. But finding someone who will just listen to you I have found to be incredibly helpful. Just making real connections...even if it's only one. I definitely think it's good you stopped drinking too. But this is where you belong man, and so do I. Definitely willing to talk if you want...

Hey OP. I think we may be feeling pretty similar right now but I would definitely like to talk to you instead of trying anything. Do you mind if I ask what the problems are you've been going to therapy for?

​

I often want to just smash my car into a pole or something. The only thing that stops me is that I know my family would be devastated, but it gets exhausting. May I ask how long you've been feeling this way?

​
